attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The entry is one sentence, carries no asterisk and no disclaimer, and gives no year and no place, so there is no dates object. The same day keeps a second Stephen, one of the two martyrs of Kazan, and the two lines are told apart by this one's epithet.
